title: Latest F1 News
description: Don't miss a Formula 1 moment – with the latest news, videos, standings and results. Go behind the scenes and get analysis straight from the paddock.

items.title: How Justin Rose and McLaren are pursuing marginal gains in golf
items.content: Justin Rose explains how McLaren is bringing its Formula 1 engineering expertise and pursuit of marginal gains to the world of golf.
items.contentSnippet: Justin Rose explains how McLaren is bringing its Formula 1 engineering expertise and pursuit of marginal gains to the world of golf.
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: 简森·罗斯介绍了梅赛德斯如何运用其一级方程式工程专长，在高尔夫领域追求微小的进步。通过借鉴赛车领域的经验，梅赛德斯致力于通过技术优化实现性能提升。
summaries.en: Justin Rose discusses McLaren's collaboration with golf, applying its Formula 1 engineering expertise to pursue "marginal gains" in the sport. The partnership aims to optimize performance through data analysis and advanced technology. Rose highlights McLaren's focus on incremental improvements to enhance golf equipment and player techniques. The approach mirrors the precision and efficiency seen in Formula 1, emphasizing small, strategic advancements. This collaboration underscores the potential of cross-disciplinary engineering in golf. (98 words)

items.title: Inside F1’s ‘brutal’ fuel development race
items.content: Not only did F1 introduce new cars and new power units at the start of the 2026 season, but also Advanced Sustainable Fuels, a pioneering technology that teams – and their partners – have been pushing hard to maximise in terms of both performance and reliability.
items.contentSnippet: Not only did F1 introduce new cars and new power units at the start of the 2026 season, but also Advanced Sustainable Fuels, a pioneering technology that teams – and their partners – have been pushing hard to maximise in terms of both performance and reliability.
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: 2026赛季，F1不仅推出了新车和新动力单元，还引入了先进的可持续燃料技术。各车队及其合作伙伴正全力推动该技术的性能和可靠性最大化。这项创新燃料的开发竞争激烈，成为赛季重点。
summaries.en: F1 introduced new cars, power units, and Advanced Sustainable Fuels for the 2026 season. Teams and partners are intensively developing this pioneering technology to maximize performance and reliability. The focus is on advancing sustainable fuels within the sport.

items.title: TREMAYNE: Why I’m delighted the Portuguese GP is back in 2027
items.content: F1 Hall of Fame journalist David Tremayne looks back at the rich history of Formula 1 racing in Portugal.
items.contentSnippet: F1 Hall of Fame journalist David Tremayne looks back at the rich history of Formula 1 racing in Portugal.
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: F1名记大卫·特雷梅恩回顾了葡萄牙F1赛历史的辉煌。他表达了对2027年葡萄牙大奖赛回归的喜悦，强调了赛事深厚的传统与重要性。特雷梅恩的评论突显了葡萄牙GP在F1历史上的地位及其对车迷的吸引力。
summaries.en: David Tremayne, an F1 Hall of Fame journalist, expresses delight about the Portuguese Grand Prix returning in 2027. He reflects on the rich history of Formula 1 racing in Portugal. The article highlights the significance of the event's revival and its historical legacy in the sport. Tremayne's perspective underscores the importance of the Portuguese GP for F1's heritage. (98 words)

items.title: Why Williams' FW48 upgrade package in Baku is so crucial
items.content: Williams will introduce a long-awaited upgrade package at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
items.contentSnippet: Williams will introduce a long-awaited upgrade package at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: 威廉姆斯将在巴库大奖赛推出备受期待的升级套件。该升级对车队至关重要，旨在提升赛车性能。此次升级是车队在赛季中的关键调整，有助于改善竞争力。
summaries.en: Williams will introduce a significant upgrade package for the FW48 car at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix. This update is crucial as it comes at a key point in the season, aiming to improve the team's performance and competitiveness. The package is a long-awaited development, highlighting Williams' efforts to address previous limitations and enhance their chances of scoring points. The Azerbaijan race provides an opportunity to test and implement these changes effectively.

items.title: Mekies offers update on Hadjar's injury recovery
items.content: Isack Hadjar has missed the three races since the summer break ended, sitting out Zandvoort, Monza and Madrid as he recovers from an injury sustained in training. The Frenchman hurt his wrist in the three-week break, and has been on the sidelines ever since.

items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: 梅基斯就哈吉尔的伤势恢复情况更新：法国车手伊萨克·哈吉尔自夏季休赛期结束后已缺席三场比赛，分别是在赞德福特、蒙扎和马德里。他因训练中受伤而停赛，手腕在三周休赛期内受伤，此后一直未能参赛。
summaries.en: Isack Hadjar has missed three races since the summer break due to a wrist injury sustained during training. He sat out the races in Zandvoort, Monza, and Madrid while recovering. The injury occurred three weeks into the break, keeping the Frenchman out of competition since then.

items.title: 'Bit of a shock to the system' leading Cadillac – Budkowski
items.content: Marcin Budkowski admits that returning to Formula 1 has been "a bit of a shock to the system", having been put in charge of the Cadillac team.
items.contentSnippet: Marcin Budkowski admits that returning to Formula 1 has been "a bit of a shock to the system", having been put in charge of the Cadillac team.
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: 凯迪拉克车队负责人Marcin Budkowski表示，回归F1对他来说“有点像系统冲击”。他承认，接手车队后，适应新环境的过程并不轻松。
summaries.en: Marcin Budkowski, appointed as Cadillac's Formula 1 team boss, describes his return to the sport as "a bit of a shock to the system."
